sections.heading: C — Knowledge dossier: Licensing eligibility and documents
sections.markdown:
## C — Knowledge dossier: Licensing eligibility and documents

FACT_ID: sec02-F01 | anchor: A05
South Dakota requires a driver license for operating a motor vehicle or motor-driven cycle on its public roads. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F02 | anchor: A05
A holder of a valid noncommercial license from another state must apply for a South Dakota license within 90 days after establishing South Dakota residency. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F03 | anchor: A05
A nonresident who is at least 16 may drive in South Dakota using a valid operator license issued by the nonresident’s home state. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F04 | anchor: A05
A person driving a motor vehicle in South Dakota must keep the driver license immediately available in the person’s possession. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F05 | anchor: A05
The handbook’s minimum age for obtaining a South Dakota driver license is 14. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F06 | anchor: A05
An applicant younger than 18 needs a parent’s or guardian’s consent on every driver-license application. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F07 | anchor: A05
Applicants for a South Dakota driver license must provide the required documents and pass the tests that apply to their application. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F08 | anchor: A05
Obtaining a South Dakota driver license requires surrendering the driver licenses and identification cards the applicant already holds. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F09 | anchor: A05
An applicant cannot currently have driving privileges suspended, revoked or denied in South Dakota or another state when obtaining a South Dakota driver license. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F10 | anchor: A05
The handbook excludes applicants whom a court has found mentally incompetent, alcoholic or habitually using illegal drugs. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F11 | anchor: A05
The licensing eligibility list requires an applicant to have no unpaid fines for moving traffic violations. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F12 | anchor: A05
The handbook’s licensing eligibility requirements include being legally present in the United States. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F13 | anchor: A05
An applicant from another country must be able to show USCIS documents specifying the dates of authorized presence in the United States. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F14 | anchor: A05
An application and residence-address documents are required each time a person applies for a South Dakota license or identification card. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F15 | anchor: A05
Photocopied documents do not meet the handbook’s licensing-document requirements. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F16 | anchor: A05
For renewal of a license or identification card that has a star on its front, the current starred credential is a required document. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F17 | anchor: A05
The starred-credential renewal route requires 2 documents proving a South Dakota physical address, each less than 1 year old. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F18 | anchor: A05
Under the starred-credential renewal list, noncitizens and people transferring from another state must provide evidence of lawful United States status. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F19 | anchor: A05
A person whose name differs from the starred credential being renewed must provide a marriage certificate, divorce decree or court order proving the change. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F20 | anchor: A05
For replacement of a South Dakota credential that had a front-side star, the primary document may be a certified United States birth certificate, valid United States passport or passport card, citizenship or naturalization certificate, valid permanent-resident card, valid employment-authorization card, or a foreign passport with United States visa and I-94. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F21 | anchor: A05
The starred-credential replacement route also requires a second identity document, such as a Social Security card, W-2, military or tribal identification, or another examiner-approved document. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F22 | anchor: A05
Replacing a South Dakota credential that had a front-side star requires 2 physical-address documents from South Dakota that are less than 1 year old. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F23 | anchor: A05
A name change on the starred-credential replacement route requires proof through a marriage certificate, divorce decree or court order. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec02-F24 | anchor: A06
A new South Dakota license or identification-card applicant, including an interstate transfer applicant, needs 1 document establishing date of birth, identity and lawful status or presence. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-F25 | anchor: A06
For the initial-application identity document, the handbook recommends choosing a document bearing the current full legal name when possible so a name change need not be documented. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-F26 | anchor: A06
An unexpired United States passport or passport card is an accepted primary identity document for a new South Dakota license or identification card. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-F27 | anchor: A06
A state-issued United States birth certificate used as primary identity proof must be certified and carry the issuing authority’s stamp or raised seal; a hospital birth certificate is unacceptable. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-F28 | anchor: A06
A Puerto Rico birth certificate used for primary identity proof must have been certified as issued on or after July 1, 2010. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-F29 | anchor: A06
Accepted State Department proof of a birth abroad includes Form FS-240, DS-1350 or FS-545. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-F30 | anchor: A06
An unexpired permanent-resident card on Form I-551 is accepted as primary identity proof for a new South Dakota credential. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-F31 | anchor: A06
An unexpired employment-authorization card on Form I-766 is accepted as primary identity proof for a new South Dakota credential. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-F32 | anchor: A06
An I-94 arrival-and-departure record with a photograph attached and a Temporary Proof of Lawful Permanent Resident stamp is an accepted primary identity document. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-F33 | anchor: A06
An I-94 arrival-and-departure record stamped Refugee, Parolee or Asylee is another accepted primary identity document. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-F34 | anchor: A06
An unexpired foreign passport may serve as primary identity proof when accompanied by an approved I-94 documenting the applicant’s latest admission to the United States. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0006]

Misconceptions: A hospital birth record is not the certified birth certificate described in the facts; renewal, replacement and initial applications must keep their own document conditions.
Mnemonics: Use route, identity, name, Social Security, then address as a retrieval cue; the cue adds no eligibility rule.
Glossary: Lawful presence concerns authorized presence in the country; a name-chain document connects the identity-document name to the current legal name; a personal mailbox is distinct from a maintained residence.
Dynamic facts: Fees, contact channels and accepted-document policies require issuer refresh. Fee facts describe the printed schedule, not a guaranteed current price; office contacts are withheld from learner facts.

ranked.label: Pedagogic emphasis: Match eligibility and each document requirement to the correct application route.

items.why: Initial, renewal and replacement applications have different document conditions; practice must retain those routes.

corpus_stability.reason: The official dated snapshot is pinned, but revision frequency has not been measured. Unknown cadence remains blocked for release pending the section-A verification debt; this is not a claim that the handbook is volatile.
